risks: The close's mutation check will likely refuse while `tests/acceptance/W2-105/` stays in the implementer ticket's `allowed_paths`. The batch is done, so removing that line from the ticket (the CTO's edit) clears it; it changes no code and no test. The W2-96 and W2-112 cases may go red again under load at the close.
lessons: W2-105's suite builds its project once per session in `make_project`, so a fixture-wide change goes there. The integration store's retrieval runs full-text only when Ollama is unavailable, and its EMBEDDER_UNAVAILABLE lines come before the JSON on standard output.
proposed_decisions: none from me. For the CTO: remove `tests/acceptance/W2-105/` from DAEO-3r1j's `allowed_paths` and add DEC-980 and DEC-968 to its `sources` before the land. Recommended, high confidence; it blocks only the close's core-mutation check.
